stories.title: Everything you need to know for NFL Week 2: 15 games on deck, 15 previews from our reporters and experts
stories.summary: Minnesota vs. Chicago? Trevor Lawrence vs. Bo Nix? There are more games left in Week 2, and we have picks, predictions, key stats, watchability ratings and more.

stories.title: Joey Porter Jr.'s future: 'Don't know if he ever puts on a Steelers uniform again'
stories.summary: The future of Pittsburgh's No. 1 cornerback with the team he grew up around remains unclear. Here's what we know.

stories.title: Yankees' Judge returns to injured list with calf strain
stories.summary: Yankees slugger Aaron Judge is returning to the IL after suffering a right calf strain. He had played just seven games since returning from a lengthy absence for a broken rib.

stories.title: Heat lock up Larsson on 4-year, $60M extension
stories.summary: The Heat and guard Pelle Larsson have reached agreement on a four-year, $60 million extension his agents told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Sources: Jazz, George reach $157.5M extension
stories.summary: The Utah Jazz and guard Keyonte George have agreed to a five-year, $157.5 million contract extension, sources told ESPN.
